title: What the Ukrainian Strikes on Yandex Tell Us About Central Asia’s Digital Infrastructure
author: Catherine Putz
text:
Credit: Wikimedia Commons / Elena Yastrebov
Over the last weekend, three Yandex facilities in Russia have been struck by Ukrainian drones, with Russian users subsequently reporting outages across Yandex’s services. After the third strike, on a data center east of Moscow in Vladimir, Central Asian users of Yandex’s superapp Yandex Go began reporting outages too.Yandex is one of Russia’s largest technology companies, with a portfolio that resembles a hybrid of Google and Uber, but for the русский мир, the Russian world. Yandex Search holds an estimated 72 percent of market share in Russia while maintaining an estimated search engine market share in Kazakhstan of just under 30 percent. It is with its superapp, Yandex Go – which combines ride-sharing with food delivery and other services – that Yandex dominates in Central Asia.[...]
